hero.heading: Understand your tax obligations with Nitidez
hero.description: Manage your invoices, clients and expenses in one place while understanding every tax obligation.

highlights.dailyTitle: IRPF and VAT up to date, at a glance
highlights.dailyDesc: See the real state of your accounts each quarter
highlights.invoicesDesc: Issue invoices, record expenses, track who has paid you and stay on top of your obligations.
highlights.verifactuDesc: Add your Digital Certificate. Validate with Verifactu. Integrate Claude.ai. No extra costs, no limits.

problem.label: Nitidez is also predictability
problem.heading: Say goodbye to end-of-quarter surprises
problem.description: Invoices, expenses, clients, suppliers and intra-community management always available. Verifactu and Claude.ai integration for daily tasks.
problem.conclusion: Finally a tool on our side.

audience.label: Who it's for
audience.heading: Built for a specific kind of freelancer
audience.description:
• You're a freelancer in Spain. 
• You keep track of Clients and Suppliers. 
• You work in services: no inventory, no employees. 
• You have clients in Spain, EU or abroad. 
• You're comfortable with numbers and want to understand your own finances. 
• You have an accountant, or not.

models.modelo130Desc: Your fractional IRPF payment, calculated on the cumulative net income for the year.
models.modelo303Desc: Output VAT minus deductible VAT, ready every quarter with no manual reconciliation
models.retaDesc: Your Social Security contribution factored into the calculation, not as a separate surprise.

scope.label: Honest Scope
scope.heading: What Nitidez.es is not
scope.description: It doesn't replace an accountant in complex situations. It doesn't handle payroll, modules, or multiple simultaneous activities. It doesn't file anything on your behalf. It puts you in charge of your numbers so you understand every obligation before it's due.
